title: Pure Gigo
summary: Lore-accurate Gigo beatdown and Rank 4 WATER build uniting every form of Gagagigo—Gigobyte, Jigabyte, Gagagigo, Giga Gagagigo, Gogiga Gagagigo, and Gagagigo the Risen—with his lore partner Eria the Water Charmer and A Legendary Ocean.

summary.title: Starters
points: Rescue Rabbit banishes itself on field to Special Summon 2 copies of Level 4 Gagagigo (or Level 1 Gigobyte) directly from the Deck.
Unexpected Dai Special Summons Gagagigo or Gigobyte from the Deck while you control no monsters without using your Normal Summon.
Warrior of Atlantis discards itself to search A Legendary Ocean, or Normal Summons as a 1900 ATK Level 4 WATER body.
Jigabyte Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Spellcaster monster (Eria the Water Charmer or Eria the Water Charmer, Gentle).

summary.title: Opening: Rescue Rabbit + Jigabyte (or Unexpected Dai)
steps: Activate Unexpected Dai to summon Gagagigo from the Deck, or Normal Summon Rescue Rabbit and banish it to Special Summon 2 copies of Gagagigo.

Overlay 2 Level 4 WATER monsters into Number 4: Stealth Kragen for Quick Effect destruction, or add a third Level 4 monster (such as Warrior of Atlantis) to overlay 3 Level 4s into signature boss Gagagigo the Risen.
Alternatively, link off a WATER monster and any second monster into Link-2 Eria the Water Charmer, Gentle, then Special Summon Jigabyte from your hand.

Send face-up Spellcaster Eria and Level 4 WATER Jigabyte from your field to the GY to Special Summon Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte directly from your Deck, ripping 1 random card from the opponent's hand.

summary.title: A Legendary Ocean & Normal Monster Beatdown
summary.text: A Legendary Ocean (always treated as Umi) boosts all WATER monsters on the field by 200 ATK/DEF and reduces the Level of all WATER monsters in both hands and on the field by 1. Under A Legendary Ocean, Level 5 Giga Gagagigo becomes a Level 4 2650 ATK monster that can be Normal Summoned with 0 Tributes, and Level 8 Gogiga Gagagigo becomes a Level 7 3150 ATK monster requiring only 1 Tribute.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Gagagigo the Risen (Rank 4 requiring 3 Level 4 monsters) brings 2950 ATK and 2800 DEF to the board, growing to 3150 ATK under A Legendary Ocean or 3450 ATK alongside Mistar Boy.

Awakening of the Possessed - Gagigobyte sends 1 random card from the opponent's hand to the GY when Special Summoned by its own effect (then both players draw 1 card), and searches a Spiritual Water Art or Possessed Spell/Trap when sent from the field to the GY.

Number 4: Stealth Kragen turns all face-up monsters on the field into WATER, destroys 1 WATER monster the opponent controls once per turn as a Quick Effect to burn for half its ATK, and floats into Stealth Kragen Spawns when destroyed.
Eria the Water Charmer, Gentle revives a WATER monster from the opponent's GY to her linked zone, enables Jigabyte and Gagigobyte, and searches a 1500 DEF WATER monster when destroyed.
